title: Strict henselization is ind-etale over an affine chart
statement: Let S be a scheme, s:Spec Ω→S an algebraically closed geometric point, i:Spec R→S an affine open immersion containing the image of the closed point of s, A a commutative ring, e:Spec A≅S_(s), and a:R→A a ring map whose spectrum composed with i equals e followed by the strict henselization structural map. Equip A with the algebra structure induced by a. Then A is ind-etale over R.

proof.text: Factor the geometric point through i using the singleton spectrum of the field. Apply etale_local_ring_triples to obtain cofilteredness of affine pointed neighbourhoods, cofinality of the chart subcategory, the equivalence E with residue triples, the diagram comparison and compatible universal colimit cocones cn and c. Transfer cofilteredness to the full chart subcategory and filteredness along E. Cocone naturality shows the composites from R agree along every morphism; a common filtered successor shows all composites agree, giving rho.

The inverse small-model equivalence followed by strictHenselizationAffineInclusion is an equivalence onto the full affine category. Its opposite final-functor colimit isomorphism cmp0 identifies the actual small representative colimit strictHenselizationRing with the full affine colimit. Compose with the unique isomorphism to cn and its given isomorphism to c to obtain ringIso. On any small representative, the inverse coprojection equation for cmp0 and the Spec-global-sections identification turn the full affine cone structural map into the characterizing composite of exists_strictHenselizationStructuralMap. This proves compatibility of the small and full structural morphisms.

Use the pointed chart object in the chart subcategory. The R-map clause of the diagram comparison and its coprojection equation identify the image of the chart coprojection with rho. Cancel ringIso.hom to obtain the chart coprojection into the small colimit. Taking spectra and using the structural-map comparison from the preceding step shows that Spec(rho followed by ringIso.inv), followed by i, is strictHenselizationStructuralMap.

The affine category is essentially small by its equivalence with the ring-written representative category; the full chart subcategory inherits essential smallness. Whisker c by the inverse small-model equivalence of the opposite chart category followed by E, obtaining a small filtered ring colimit presentation. Full faithfulness of Spec sends the prescribed e to a ring isomorphism eRing to A. Transport the cocone to A along ringIso.symm followed by eRing. Cancel the mono i in ha and apply Spec faithfulness to identify the transported R-map with a. The structural maps of triples define a natural transformation from constant R; every stage is etale by HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff and each composite with its cocone leg equals a. RingHom.IndEtale.iff_exists gives the conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04HX (lemma-describe-etale-local-ring), affine chart and triples colimit; Tag 04GW (lemma-strict-henselization-different); C4 repair on 2026-10-17 adds the small representative colimit comparison and proves structural-map compatibility against upstream e47efb5a5, adapting returned commit 3cc76cfb5.

theorem strictHenselization_indEtale_of_affine_chart
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω A : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (i : Spec R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (hs : s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ∈ Set.range i)
    (e : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s)
    (a : R →+* A)
    (ha : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a) ≫ i =
      e.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) :
    letI : Algebra R A := a.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IndEtale R A
